draft_key_information_units.information: Q1 2026 consolidated revenue increased 22.4% to MEUR 87.0, with net profit rising 25.7% to MEUR 5.1.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Section 2 'Main financial indicators' table and text: Revenue Q1 2026 MEUR 86,970 (+22.4% YoY), Net profit Q1 2026 MEUR 5,085 (+25.7% YoY).

draft_key_information_units.information: Q1 2026 EBITDA fell 50.2% to MEUR 3.0, excluding MEUR 5.5 preliminary negative goodwill from the Marijampolės acquisition.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Section 2 text: 'During Q1 2026 EBITDA reached MEUR 3.0 (a decrease of 50.2% compared to the same period last year). In Q1 2026 EBITDA excludes preliminary negative goodwill of MEUR 5.5...'

draft_key_information_units.information: Acquisition of Marijampolės pieno konservai UAB completed on 16 January 2026, adding canned milk and milk powder production capabilities.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Section 1 'Main events': 'On 16 January 2026, Vilkyškių pieninė AB completed the transaction for the acquisition of shares of Marijampolės pieno konservai UAB. 100% of the company’s shares were acquired.'

draft_key_information_units.information: Commercial cheese production commenced at the new Baltic Dairy Board SIA factory in Bauska, Latvia, targeting 18 thousand tons annually for export to over 40 countries.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Section 1 and Structure section: 'VILVI Group has started commercial cheese production in Latvia... planned cheese production volumes will reach 18 thousand tons per year. These products will be exported to more than 40 countries worldwide.'

draft_key_information_units.information: Q1 2026 revenue segment mix shifted to 43% cheese/dairy products, 28% dry milk products, 15% fresh milk products, and 14% canned milk (new segment from acquisition).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Section 4 'Sales revenue by operating segments' table and picture text: Q1 2026 segments shown with canned milk at 14% (consolidated from 2026-01-01).

draft_key_information_units.information: Q1 2026 sales geography shifted to 59% EU (up from 53% in 2025), 17% Lithuania (up from 12% in 2025), and 34% other countries.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Section 3 'Sales revenue by markets' table and picture text: EU 59% (Q1 2026), Lithuania 17% (Q1 2026), Other countries 34% (Q1 2026).

draft_key_information_units.information: Net financial debt surged 89.7% to MEUR 83.4 in Q1 2026, compared to MEUR 44.0 at end of 2025.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Section 2 table: 'Net financial debt, thousands EUR' Q1 2026 83,427 (+89.7% vs Q1 2025). Section 5 balance sheet confirms position as of 31/03/2026.

draft_key_information_units.information: Operating cash flow was negative MEUR 9.6 million in Q1 2026, funded by financing activities (MEUR 15.8 million) and partially offset by investing outflows (MEUR 8.0 million).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Section 7 'Consolidated statement of cash flows': Net cash flows from operating activities -(9,633), investing -(8,037), financing +15,836 (all in thousands EUR).

draft_key_information_units.information: Purchased milk equivalents increased 54.2% to 155,954 tons in Q1 2026, compared to 101,118 tons in Q1 2025.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Section 2 table: 'Purchased basic indicators milk, in tons' Q1 2026 155,954 (+54.2% YoY).
